name: Badlands National Park
unique: Striped eroding buttes, bighorn sheep and the largest protected mixed-grass prairie in the country, with a loop road that puts you inside the formations.
buzz: Sunrise and sunset turn the rock orange; midday is flat. Watch for bison on the road and rattlesnakes on trails.

name: Custer State Park
company: South Dakota Game, Fish and Parks
unique: A 1,300-head bison herd, begging burros, granite spires and the Needles Highway — a road that threads through rock tunnels barely wider than a car.
buzz: The wildlife loop is the highlight; the Needles Highway is genuinely thrilling. Bison jams can last an hour.

name: Mount Rushmore
unique: Four sixty-foot faces blasted into granite over fourteen years, with a night lighting ceremony and a sculptor's studio that shows how it was done.
buzz: People are surprised how moved they are; the evening lighting is the best time. Parking is the only cost.

name: Wind Cave
unique: One of the longest caves in the world and the first national park for a cave, famous for boxwork — thin calcite fins that look like honeycomb.
buzz: The natural entrance tour is the classic; rangers explain the barometric wind that breathes in and out of the cave. Book ahead.

name: Sturgis Motorcycle Rally
unique: Half a million motorcycles take over a town of 7,000 for a week, with concerts, a mile of vendors and the Black Hills as the ride.
buzz: It is loud, hot and utterly singular; non-riders love the spectacle. Book lodging a year ahead or camp.

name: Crazy Horse Memorial
unique: A mountain being carved into a 563-foot horseman since 1948, with a Native American museum, a sculptor's home and a laser show at night.
buzz: The scale is staggering and the progress is slow; the museum is excellent and the controversy is worth understanding.

name: Deadwood
unique: A gold-rush gulch town where Wild Bill Hickok was shot, with the actual-saloon rebuilds, a cemetery on the hill and legal casino poker in every other storefront.
buzz: The history is well presented and the town is fun; the casino carpet is part of the charm. Catch the trial reenactment.

name: Wall Drug
unique: A drugstore that became a 76,000-square-foot roadside empire on the strength of free ice water and a hundred miles of billboards, with a giant jackalope and a chapel.
buzz: It is a tourist trap that knows it and leans in; the donuts and the free water are the tradition. A perfect Badlands pit stop.

name: Corn Palace
unique: A 1921 Moorish-style palace whose facade is re-covered every year in murals made of eleven colors of corn and grain.
buzz: It is free, fast and better than the jokes suggest; the interior is a basketball arena. Worth the I-90 stop.
